event.description:
ENTRY:
- $50

START TIME:
- 12:00 pm

FORMAT:
- Constructed

STRUCTURE:
- 60 Min Swiss Rounds
- +5 Min/+3 Turns Overtime
- Best of 3
- NO Top Cut
- Decklists Required


PRIZES:
~~ PROMOS
[1st]
- Nationals Invite
- Regional Champion Playmat
[Top 8]
- Nationals Invite
- Regionals Finalist Playmats

~~ BOOSTERS
[Participation]
- Regional Binder
- Booster Pack
- Event Pack
- Each player should get one Sapphire Pack upon entry to the event
- Proxia's Vault Pack

*All remaining Sapphire Packs should be distributed to the top players, with a higher quantity going to the players with a higher placing.
*Each player will get one Event Pack upon entry to the event, all other event packs should be split among the top players.

**All promotional items subject to availability.**


If you have any questions regarding events at Good Games Adelaide please don’t hesitate to contact us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ggadelaide or call us: (08) 8121 7878
